title: An action taken in this outreach
description: One append-only record per action. Write a new file; never edit an old one. The file name is <utc-timestamp>__<target>__<verb>.json.

id.description: Stable id, unique in this vault.

at.description: UTC, RFC3339. When it happened, not when it was written up.

actor.description: Who acted: an agent name, or a person's role. Be specific: 'riskmandate.ai outreach agent' or 'editor'.

verb.description: A closed list on purpose. If none of these fits, the action is 'noted' with the summary saying what happened. Do not invent a verb; propose one in a noted action instead.

target.description: An organisation slug from targets/, or 'all'.

to.description: The ROLE address or public profile written to. Never a personal email address of a natural person.

stands_on.description: What this action rests on: a SHA-256 from the corpus vault's MANIFEST.json, a URL on newsroom.sgit.ai, or the id of an earlier action here. An action that stands on nothing is an assertion.

summary.description: What was done, in a sentence or two. Not a transcript.

body_ref.description: Path in this vault to the full text sent or received, if any.

next.description: What this action makes due, and by when.

uncertain.description: Anything you are not sure of. Fill this rather than rounding it off.
